people_gender_check.name: people_gender_check
people_gender_check.value: gender IS NULL OR gender IN ('male', 'female')

people_birth_month_check.name: people_birth_month_check
people_birth_month_check.value: birth_month IS NULL OR birth_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12

people_birth_day_check.name: people_birth_day_check
people_birth_day_check.value: birth_day IS NULL OR birth_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31

people_birth_year_check.name: people_birth_year_check
people_birth_year_check.value: birth_year IS NULL OR birth_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2100

people_archived_reason_check.name: people_archived_reason_check
people_archived_reason_check.value: archived_reason IS NULL OR archived_reason IN ('left', 'moved', 'deceased', 'duplicate', 'anonymised', 'other')

people_merge_consistency.name: people_merge_consistency
people_merge_consistency.value: merged_into_person_id IS NULL OR (archived_reason = 'duplicate' AND merged_into_person_id <> id)

person_designations_dates.name: person_designations_dates
person_designations_dates.value: ended_on IS NULL OR ended_on >= started_on

hierarchy_nodes_not_self_parent.name: hierarchy_nodes_not_self_parent
hierarchy_nodes_not_self_parent.value: parent_person_id IS NULL OR parent_person_id <> person_id

ministry_memberships_dates.name: ministry_memberships_dates
ministry_memberships_dates.value: ended_on IS NULL OR ended_on >= started_on

team_memberships_dates.name: team_memberships_dates
team_memberships_dates.value: left_on IS NULL OR left_on >= joined_on

role_assignment_scope_arity.name: role_assignment_scope_arity
role_assignment_scope_arity.value: num_nonnulls(scope_person_id, scope_ministry_id, scope_team_id) = CASE WHEN scope_type = 'global' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

role_assignment_branch_scope.name: role_assignment_branch_scope
role_assignment_branch_scope.value: scope_type <> 'branch' OR scope_person_id IS NOT NULL

role_assignment_ministry_scope.name: role_assignment_ministry_scope
role_assignment_ministry_scope.value: scope_type <> 'ministry' OR scope_ministry_id IS NOT NULL

role_assignment_team_scope.name: role_assignment_team_scope
role_assignment_team_scope.value: scope_type <> 'team' OR scope_team_id IS NOT NULL

role_assignment_branch_depth.name: role_assignment_branch_depth
role_assignment_branch_depth.value: branch_max_depth IS NULL OR (branch_max_depth > 0 AND scope_type = 'branch')
